guidance.statement: Target 75+ stores by FY27 with cluster-based approach ensuring cost efficiency.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Services > Retailing > Diversified Retail

operating_notes.text: Launched 51st Patel's R Mart store at Rasayani, Khalapur, Raigad.
Launched 50th store in Thakurli, Mumbai and 51st store in Rasayani, Raigad during the period.
IPO net proceeds were ₹189.39 Cr against an estimated ₹190.47 Cr; a further ₹15 Cr was raised through a Pre-IPO placement, with ICRA Limited as monitoring agency.
Of the ₹204.39 Cr objects, ₹185.21 Cr was utilised as of March 31, 2026, with no deviation or variation reported.
Operates 51 stores with 2,29,158 sq. ft. of retail space as of May 31, 2026.
Opened 52nd store (KBG Patel's R Mart) at Bapgaon, Bhiwandi, Maharashtra.
Opened 52nd store (KBG Patel's R Mart) at Bapgaon, Bhiwandi on June 6, 2026.
The company currently operates a network of 54 stores.
Two locations were finalised for upcoming stores at Ghoti in Nashik district and Mangaon/Mahad in Raigad district.
With the Ghoti store, retail presence will extend across four districts: Thane, Raigad, Palghar and Nashik.

timeline.summary: Patel Retail opened its 51st store in Khalapur, Maharashtra
Patel Retail opened its 51st store in Rasayani, Raigad district, on April 24, 2026.
Patel Retail filed its Q4 FY26 Monitoring Agency Report showing ₹19.19 Cr unutilized IPO proceeds parked in fixed deposits.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹334.16 Cr, net profit ₹9.98 Cr.
Patel Retail reported Q4 FY26 total income of ₹339.55 Cr and full-year PAT of ₹39.05 Cr, alongside opening its 50th and 51st stores.
Patel Retail filed its Reg. 32 statement for Q4/FY26: no deviation in IPO proceeds, with ₹185.21 Cr of the ₹204.39 Cr objects utilised as of March 31, 2026.
Patel Retail released its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation highlighting 51 operational stores and ₹1,048.33 Cr in operating revenue.
On June 6, 2026, Patel Retail announced the opening of its 52nd store in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra.
Patel Retail opened its 52nd store at Bapgaon, Bhiwandi, strengthening its retail presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
Patel Retail Limited’s **Khopkar Prasad Ramesh** (Company Secretary) shared Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call recording on June 8, 2026, via the company’s website.
Finalised two new store locations in Nashik (Ghoti) and Raigad (Mangaon/Mahad), expanding the retail network to 54 stores.
